title: হ চ ছ প and য়
focus: New: হ চ ছ প য়
body:
# Lesson 6: হ চ ছ প and য়

Four consonants and য় (antostho o), the letter that makes the y-glide in খায় and হয়েছে.

| Script | Sound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| হ | ho (h) | Looks like a 5 with a tail hanging below the line. |
| চ | cho (ch) | Plain ch. Its breathy twin ছ has a loop and a tail. |
| ছ | chho (ch) | Written 'ch' in the bengali pack: আছে is ache, ছোট is choto. |
| প | po (p) | Like a backwards check mark under the line; don't confuse with গ. |
| য় | antostho o: y | Dot below = y-glide; without the dot (য, next lesson) it's j. |

## How they combine

চ and ছ are both written **ch** in the romanization; ছ is just breathier. য় after a vowel is a soft **y**: খা + য় = খায় **khay**. Between vowels it often sounds like e: হয়েছে **hoyeche**.

## Read these

Cover the right side, read the script aloud, then check.

- চা → cha: tea
- হবে → hobe: will be / will happen
- আছে → ache: is (there) / has
- পারি → pari: I can
- চুপ → chup: quiet!
- খায় → khay: eats
- হয়েছে → hoyeche: has happened / is done
